'''Kotan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] watchman soldier of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he got infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]]. He was later killed by an Imperial spacer.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Infected Master Kotan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion enemy on Imperial version of Taris.<ref name="SWTOR" />
